name: Tavern Town
desc:
Use code: DECOR 
For a free crate!!

🏰 BUILD THE COZIEST TAVERN IN TOWN! 🏰

Design your own tavern from the ground up, serve hungry travelers and grow from a tiny shack into the grandest hall in the realm.

🔨 BUILD
• Walls, roofs, stairs and floors, piece by piece
• Hundreds of decorations to unlock
• Sell your designs on the Build Market

🍲 SERVE & COOK
• Pour drinks and hand out meals yourself
• Cook dishes with hands-on minigames
• Hire waitresses, chefs, bouncers and a bard band

🌲 EXPLORE
• Hunt with a bow, fish the river and mine gems
• Seasons, weather and a falling gem asteroid

🏆 COMPETE
• Server challenges with gem prizes
• Town leaderboards for hunters and anglers

⭐ GROW
• Level up and shape a huge skill tree
• Daily rewards, quests and the Tavern Pass

💎 ROBLOX PREMIUM
• Premium members get the Share Pass FREE: sell your builds on the Build Market!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!

llm.loop: build and decorate a tavern -> serve and cook for travellers -> hire staff -> hunt, fish and mine -> level a skill tree -> sell designs on build market
llm.objectives: grow from a shack into the grandest tavern
llm.progression: levels, skill tree, decorations, staff, gems
llm.thumbnails: wooden 'Tavern Town' sign, 'Go Fishing', 'Build an Aquarium' feature banners
llm.complexity_notes: building system, many side activities, NPC service
